newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT - Merrill raises '97 FTSE forecast.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Merrill raises '97 FTSE forecast.

text.p: Merrill Lynch raised its year-end forecast for the FTSE 100 index to 4,500 from 4,300, UK equity strategist Philip Wolstencroft said on Monday.

Wolstencroft said the revised FTSE forecast was prompted by a cut in bond yield targets. Another spokesman at the brokerage said "the message remains the same...gentle stock appreciation." --London Newsroom +44 171 542 4027
